evidence: Comen. OP Alph.: Canis ringitur, under R
Pers. 1.109 (Lewis & Short s.v. canīnus): littera canīna, the letter R
terms.comment: The snarl as Comenius spells it in his animal alphabet (1658); Persius already calls R the dog’s letter.

terms.gloss: growl, of dogs and big cats
evidence: Lucr. 5.1064 (Lewis & Short s.v. fremō): mollia ricta fremunt, of angry Molossian hounds

phrases.english: The dog snarls (R, err, in the animal alphabet).

sources: Lewis & Short: ringor · Lewis & Short: fremo · Lewis & Short: caninus
